title: Spire Bot - AI that plays the Ironclad to the Heart (A20) / 杀戮尖塔 AI
description:
[h1]Spire Bot[/h1]
A neural network that plays Slay the Spire by itself: the Ironclad, Ascension 20, going for the Heart. Subscribe, tick the mods in ModTheSpire, and it starts a run from the main menu and plays it to the end. Nothing to install or configure: the bot's own Python, simulator and model come with this item (Windows and Mac).

[h2]What you need[/h2]
[list]
[*]Subscribe to [b]ModTheSpire[/b], [b]BaseMod[/b] and [b]Communication Mod[/b], and tick all three plus Spire Bot in the ModTheSpire window (Steam does not tick them for you).
[*]Windows 10/11 64-bit, or a Mac with Apple silicon.
[*]A profile with Act 4 unlocked, all Ironclad cards unlocked and Ascension 20 unlocked for the Ironclad. The bot checks this and says on its panel what is missing.
[*]No unfinished Ironclad run (the bot will not overwrite it).
[*]No other mods that change cards, relics, monsters or events: the bot only knows the base game.
[*]Leave Communication Mod's own "command" setting empty: if it starts another program, Spire Bot does not start (two programs would both send commands).
[*]If you installed Spire Bot from the zip before, run its uninstall first (uninstall.bat on Windows, uninstall.sh on a Mac), then subscribe: only one copy of Spire Bot should be in the game.
[/list]

[h2]Good to know[/h2]
[list]
[*]Achievements do not unlock while mods are on (ModTheSpire turns them off).
[*]The bot's runs count in your run history and statistics like any run.
[*]Do not click or press keys while it plays. F9 pauses and resumes, F8 hides the panel, F7 switches the panel view.
[*]Logs stay on your computer (ModTheSpire's config folder, spirebot/logs). Nothing is sent anywhere.
[/list]

[h2]How well it plays[/h2]
In the real game it won the Heart in 65 of 220 runs (29.5%), or 65 of the 215 runs it played to the end (30.2%, about ±3 points): the same model without search, on a Mac, Ascension 20 Ironclad, with a game-speed mod, fixed seeds. Of the 5 runs that did not finish, 4 stopped midway (fixed since) and 1 crashed as the game window opened. This version also thinks ahead in elite and boss fights: it tries its best few plays on copies of the fight before it plays. How much that adds to the real-game win rate has not been measured yet.

Not affiliated with Mega Crit. Contains no game files.

----

[h1]Spire Bot（杀戮尖塔 AI）[/h1]
一个自己打杀戮尖塔的神经网络：铁甲战士，进阶 20，冲心脏。订阅以后在 ModTheSpire 里勾上模组，它会从主菜单自己开一局，一直打到结束。不用安装、不用配置：机器人自带的 Python、模拟器和模型都在这个条目里（Windows 和 Mac 都有）。

[h2]需要[/h2]
[list]
[*]订阅 [b]ModTheSpire[/b]、[b]BaseMod[/b] 和 [b]Communication Mod[/b]，并在 ModTheSpire 窗口里把这三个和 Spire Bot 都勾上（Steam 不会替你勾）。
[*]Windows 10/11 64 位，或 Apple 芯片的 Mac。
[*]存档里第四幕已解锁、铁甲战士的牌全部解锁、铁甲战士的进阶 20 已解锁。机器人会自己检查，缺什么会在面板上说。
[*]没有打到一半的铁甲战士存档（机器人不会覆盖它）。
[*]不要同时开改卡牌、遗物、怪物或事件的模组：机器人只认原版游戏。
[*]Communication Mod 自己的 command 设置留空：那里要是设了别的程序，Spire Bot 不会启动（两个程序会同时发命令）。
[*]以前用 zip 包装过 Spire Bot 的，先运行它的卸载（Windows 是 uninstall.bat，Mac 是 uninstall.sh），再订阅：游戏里只能有一份 Spire Bot。
[/list]

[h2]要知道的[/h2]
[list]
[*]开了模组成就不会解锁（ModTheSpire 会关掉成就）。
[*]机器人打的局和平常一样，会记进你的历史和统计。
[*]它打的时候别点鼠标、别按键。F9 暂停和继续，F8 隐藏面板，F7 切换面板视图。
[*]日志只存在你自己的电脑上（ModTheSpire 设置目录下的 spirebot/logs），不往任何地方发。
[/list]

[h2]打得怎么样[/h2]
真游戏里 220 局赢心脏 65 局（29.5%）；只算打完的 215 局是 65 局（30.2%，误差约正负 3 个点）。条件：同一个模型、不开推演，Mac，进阶 20 铁甲战士，开了游戏加速模组，固定种子。没打完的 5 局里，4 局是中途停下（已修好），1 局是开游戏窗口时崩了。这一版在精英和 Boss 战里会先推演再出牌：在这场仗的几份拷贝上试几种最好的打法，再挑一种。真游戏里胜率提高多少，还没量过。

与 Mega Crit 无关，不含任何游戏文件。
